versions.description: A single PostgreSQL server (PostgreSQL License, official image, referenced, never shipped): data on a host volume, superuser, application databases and a pg_monitor user from the built-in secret store, health checks with roles, optional TLS with Norca's workload certificates, optional periodic pg_dumpall to S3 (RustFS).
